messages:
jamal: Quick pulse — we need to schedule a 60m enablement for Aurora Clinic next week. Customer asked for an APAC-friendly slot and a short recording. Who can own the Dedicated migration section? :calendar:
maria_cs: I can run the ded migration part. Prefer a 9am PT / 5pm BST time or anything after 6pm IST. I can record if needed.
alex (solutions): I'll prepare an install checklist and a short config snippet. We should keep the demo to 20m.
sophia (product): Recommend we highlight canary rollouts + automatic fallback policies. 15–20m demo + 10m Q&A works.
jamal: SGTM. @alex please draft the checklist, @maria_cs confirm final slot. Proposed candidate times: Tue 9am PT / Wed 2pm UTC / Thu 7am AEST — pick one? :thumbsup:
maria_cs: I'll run a quick poll in the doc. Also can we cap live attendees to 10–12 so it's hands-on?
alan-cs-bot: Note: If account usage < 12k tokens/day, include renewal-risk brief in agenda. See internal playbook: https://intranet.redwood/renewals/health-checks — auto-cc assigned success lead.
jamal: Added renewal risk item. Also want to capture a 3-question post-session survey (ease, usefulness, next-steps).
maria_cs: Draft agenda (will paste into invite):
1) Welcome + goals (5m)
2) Onboarding checklist & preflight (10m)
3) Dedicated migration walkthrough (20m)
4) Canary rollout demo (15m)
5) Renewal health check & next steps (5m)
6) Q&A (5m)
Ill share recording and notes after.
alex (solutions): Dropping the config snippet here for the migration demo:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 6
  policy: latency
scheduling:
  preferred_zones: [ap-southeast-1,ap-northeast-1]
```
sophia (product): That looks good. Can we add a slide on graceful degradation/fallback matrix? 1 slide.
jamal: Yes. Also assigning follow-ups to me for action items. If no objections I'll book Tue 9am PT and send a calendar invite with the agenda + survey link.
maria_cs: Sounds good — I'll publish the poll and RSVP request.
alex (solutions): I'll upload the checklist doc to the invite and make sure the demo environment creds are ready.
sophia (product): +1 — thanks all.
jamal: Thanks everyone — will post invite in this thread when done.
